notes: «أن رجلا، من أهل العراق سأل ابن عمر» : the asker is a man in the story Abd al-Rahman tells, so he is in the scene, not a link (rule 6); Ibn Umar is the one asked and answers, and his «سمعت رسول الله» makes him the last link
The first «أبي» is the father of Wahb b. Jarir, unnamed: relation link
Tirmidhi's remarks «وقد رواه شعبة ومهدي بن ميمون» and «قد روي عن أبي هريرة ... نحو هذا» name other transmitters: variant groups, not routes (rule 4)
